items.content_html: Pendant MCP is a local-first wearable AI agent. A lightweight pendant (mic, camera, IMU, haptics, kill-switch) streams speech and snapshots via BLE to your phone—the local AI brain and encrypted vault. Using local MCP servers, it turns daily moments into real actions (calendar, notes, expenses) via a 4-tab app, with zero cloud risk.

items.content_html: This site uses the amazing Astro.build project. I added **Google Docs** integration to serve as a lightweight, serverless backend to process and store basic data.
